claim: On January 22, 2025 Client VPN added concurrent VPN connections: a user can connect to multiple VPN profiles at the same time, with the AWS-supplied client version 5.0 or later; before, only one VPN profile at a time.
question: What changed about how many VPN profiles one Client VPN user can connect to at once?

evidence.quote: Previously, you could only connect to one VPN profile at a time.
This feature is available only with AWS-supplied Client VPN client version 5.0+.

changed.was: you could only connect to one VPN profile at a time

claim: In the AWS pricing example for Client VPN, you pay an endpoint hourly fee for the Client VPN endpoint and a connection hourly fee for the active Client VPN connections.
question: Which hourly fees make up Client VPN pricing?

qualifiers.scope: per Client VPN endpoint and per connection

evidence.quote: AWS Client VPN endpoint hourly fee: For this AWS Region, you pay $0.10 per hour in AWS Client VPN endpoint hourly fees.
AWS Client VPN connection hourly fee: Ten AWS Client VPN connections were active for 1 hour. You pay $0.50 per hour in AWS Client VPN connection fees.

note: d12-093. Example only: the page states no separate rule that the endpoint fee is per associated subnet; no dollar amount goes into the book.
